source_caption_text:
Five out of five stars for ‘Starboy’ ⭐️

It was 10 years ago today that @theweeknd released ‘Starboy.’ The album debuted at no. 1, won a Grammy, and features some of the artist’s best collabs, including tracks with Kendrick Lamar, Daft Punk, and Lana Del Rey. 

The Weeknd also announced 'Starboy Decade Collection. The commemorative physical album releases include a 2LP Picture Disc, deluxe CD with poster, and Target-exclusive 2LP in marbled red and an Urban Outfitters-exclusive 2LP in marbled orange.
